Draw zero-mean Gaussian B-spline coefficients

Source: R/axons.R
dot-draw_coefficients.Rd

Draws one coefficient vector per coordinate (X, Y, Z) per axon from a zero-mean multivariate normal with covariance .bspline_covariance(). Returns one n_basis x n_axons matrix per coordinate.

Usage

.draw_coefficients(n_basis, variance, autocorrelation, n_axons, seed = NULL)

Arguments

n_basis

Number of B-spline coefficients per coordinate.

variance

Coefficient variance.

autocorrelation

Correlation rate.

n_axons

Number of independent draws.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

Value

A list with elements X, Y, Z, each an n_basis x n_axons matrix.
